notes.title: E-Shop Tycoon Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]We are excited to announce that the demo of E-Shop Tycoon is now available! 
[/h1]

Now, after a year's of hard work, a demo version with a short gameplay is available for our valued players to try.

In this demo version, you can experience most of the basic mechanics, although it's just the beginning. For now, the demo only includes the garage stage and the first objectives. There is an estimated 30-40 minutes of gameplay.

Keep in mind that the demo version may have bugs and will not provide a full game experience. You can report these bugs and feedback to us via our [url=https://discord.gg/zbUnvxCFpd]Discord[/url] server.
